arguments.question: Can we purchase food contact items or gaskets from a supplier without a food-grade certificate?

content: No, we cannot buy them from that supplier. Under Rasoi purchase policy (POL-PUR-001 §6.2), parts that touch food—such as gaskets—may only be purchased from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if their price is lower, an order cannot be placed until a valid certificate is uploaded and verified.

arguments.question: new supplier onboarding food contact silicone gasket register supplier policy
food-contact items food grade certificate supplier policy
thresholds for direct order and purchase request PR approval limit
quotation supplier onboarding food-grade certificate purchase order

content:
We cannot place this order yet. Shakti Seals is not registered in Bahi, and because the 5-litre silicone gasket touches food, POL-PUR-001 §6.2 and POL-SUP-003 §4.1 require an accredited food-grade test report on file before any order can be placed.

To onboard them, we must first collect their PAN, bank details, signed Supplier Code of Conduct, and food-grade certificate (POL-SUP-003 §3.2). Furthermore, the ₹2,08,000 value exceeds the ₹50,000 direct-order threshold (MAN-PUR-72 §17.4), requiring an approved purchase request from Rohit Mehta.

Our approved supplier with a valid food-grade certificate is Deccan Polymers (DP-RJK-0042) if you need gaskets ordered for 2 Nov 2026.
